args.body: Hi Eve! I just had a look at your blog at www.eve-blog.com. I love that it centers on a passion like hiking — it gives the blog a clear personality and makes it easy to follow. A couple of ideas to make it even stronger: sharing photos and details from your hikes (trails, gear, maps) would bring the content to life, and adding a few recent posts or an archive would make it easier for visitors to browse. You might also include a short "About" section and links to your socials. Overall, a warm and inviting blog with a great theme — I'd love to read more!
